1	customer kicked back the lot we ran on 2026-09-18 on vmc 3, our old fanuc 0i-MF. three part numbers were in that lot, MNF-0610, BRG-1140 and LVR-2205. before anyone edits a program the quality lead wants a STEP of each part exactly the way it came off the machine that day, so we can lay it over the print and see what went wrong.
2	
3	problem is the machine kept running after that. what i pulled off the control this morning is in `/app/cnc`. `ALL-PROG.TXT` is the program punch, `CNC-PARA.TXT` parameters, `TOOLOFST.TXT` offsets, `EXT_WKZ.TXT` work offsets and `OPRT-HIS.TXT` the operation history. thats the state today, not on the 18th. people changed things in between and the history only reaches back so far. QC kept the CMM reports of three serials of each part from that lot, they are in `/app/qc` as PC-DMIS text and the nominals in there are print nominals. `/app/shop` has the tool crib sheet with presetter lengths, tool shapes and recent tool changes, the vise setup, and a setup sheet per part.

All three parts must pass for reward 1; one pytest test per part feeds the CTRF report. How the truth was made and checked: the sealed solids come from an explicit lot-day state kept apart from the solver (dev/state0918); the reference solver, given only what the agent gets, reconstructs that state (history rollback matches it exactly, the G56 shift is fitted to +0.300, old T6 and the Y turnover are selected) and reproduces the sealed solids with volume difference 0, symmetric difference 0 and deviation 0; an independent point classifier that decides analytically whether a point lies inside any tool position along any feed move agrees with OCCT on 18000 random points and 12000 points concentrated near features, zero mismatches; the CMM reports were measured off the sealed solids with 1.5 micron noise. A battery of 17 wrong reconstructions rebuilt with the same engine all score 0: today's state with no rollback, today's state patched with the CMM-visible fixes only, DPI, EXT, H3 wear or D7 wear not rolled back, the G56 shift missed, today's T6, the old T6 with H6 left at today's value, OP20 turned over about X as the setup sheet says, and six control semantics misreadings (M98 own local level, mirror without arc reversal, H taken from the loaded tool, G52 accumulating, vacant argument as zero, M99 restoring G90) plus the bull nose as a flat endmill. 7	author_name = "Anand Pahade"
8	author_email = "bryandavidson737@gmail.com"
9	difficulty_explanation = """In industry this is a manufacturing or quality engineer doing a forensic virtual machining study: a customer rejected a lot, the CAD is gone, and the question is what the old Fanuc 0i-MF machining centre actually cut on the day the lot ran (2026-09-18). The agent gets the control backup taken today (ALL-PROG.TXT punch with custom macro B, CNC-PARA.TXT, TOOLOFST.TXT memory C offsets, EXT_WKZ.TXT work offsets), the control's operation history export OPRT-HIS.TXT, PC-DMIS CMM reports of three serials per part from that lot, and the shop's tool crib sheet, vise data and setup sheets, and must deliver STEP solids of the three parts as cut that day within 0.02 mm, including every feature the CMM never measured. Nothing hands over the lot-day state. The history buffer wrapped and starts 2026-09-24, so the logged changes after the lot must be undone in order (EXT Z, H3 and D7 wear, and parameter 3401#0 DPI, which was 1 on the lot day, so a spotface typed Z-6 was cut 6 mm deep, not 0.006), with decoy changes on unused offsets mixed in. What the history cannot reach has to be diagnosed from the CMM data against a forward model of the cut: every BRG-1140 feature sits 0.3 mm off in X (G56 was re-touched before the history starts); the row and through holes measure 6.8, not 6.6, because the lot ran before the 09-22 drill swap noted on the crib sheet, so the old 118 degree HSS drill and its length apply, and with the program's G43 H5 call on T6 that longer drill puts the MNF-0610 holes through where today's drill leaves them blind; and the MNF-0610 back side bore measures 10 mm off along X while the through holes sit where they should, which only a turnover about Y instead of the setup sheet's X explains, which also moves the unmeasured counterbore. All of this sits on top of exact Fanuc execution (M98 sharing locals so one of four commented counterbores is cut, G52 replacing, vacant macro arguments, G91 canned cycle R/Z with K, M99 keeping G91 so a hole is drilled in air, G51.1 arc reversal, G68, a wrong H number, cutter compensation with wear) and swept tool geometry (drill points, chamfer mill tip, a bull nose ridge, a pocket macro whose sharp cornered roughing gouges its own R8 corners). A local probe of the earlier forward-only version showed a strong agent applying every documented control rule correctly within minutes; this version makes the agent reconstruct an unknown machine state from indirect, noisy evidence and propagate it to unmeasured features, all or nothing across three parts. The parts, programs, history and measurements are synthetic, written for this task; the file formats, the control semantics and the tooling are real."""
10	solution_explanation = """Roll the backup back with the history: walk OPRT-HIS.TXT newest first and restore every logged old value (offsets, work offsets, parameters) after 2026-09-18, checking that each entry chains onto the current value; confirm that none of the programs used was edited. Build a forward model: a Fanuc 0i macro B interpreter (local levels for G65 not M98, vacant arguments, DPI per 3401#0, modal state through M99, G52, G68, G51.1, G43 geometry+wear of the H called and the real length of the tool loaded, type A cutter compensation, R and IJ arcs, canned cycles with G91 and K) feeding exact OCCT swept volumes cut from the stock as located by the vise data. Measure the modelled parts like the QC program (datum A bottom, B front, C left; holes, pocket walls and floor, slot, heights) and compare with the averaged CMM serials. Open questions are settled by evidence: the old T6 (6.8, 118 degree point, 126.880 long, with H6 still holding that length) is the only drill that reproduces the measured diameters and blind hole depths; the BRG residuals are a common X offset of +0.300 on every G56 feature, applied to G56; MNF OP20 turned over about X leaves an 8 mm residual that no G55 shift removes, turned over about Y it fits to 0.002. Keep the one reading that matches every characteristic within noise and export the three solids. The reference (solution/history.py, fanuc.py, cut.py, cmm.py, parts.py, models.py) does this in about two minutes."""
11	verification_explanation = """For each of the three parts the verifier reads /app/models/<part>.step with OCCT (cadquery-ocp) and compares it with the sealed lot-day solid. Gates, in order: exactly one solid that passes BRepCheck; volume within 1e-4 of the sealed one; the 24 proper axis rotations (no reflections) filtered by bounding box sizes to 0.05 mm, translated so the boxes coincide, smallest symmetric difference kept; that non-overlapping volume below 2e-4 of the sealed volume; a 5 by 5 parametric grid of points on every face of both solids within 0.02 mm of the other solid's boundary. All three parts must pass for reward 1; one pytest test per part feeds the CTRF report. How the truth was made and checked: the sealed solids come from an explicit lot-day state kept apart from the solver (dev/state0918); the reference solver, given only what the agent gets, reconstructs that state (history rollback matches it exactly, the G56 shift is fitted to +0.300, old T6 and the Y turnover are selected) and reproduces the sealed solids with volume difference 0, symmetric difference 0 and deviation 0; an independent point classifier that decides analytically whether a point lies inside any tool position along any feed move agrees with OCCT on 18000 random points and 12000 points concentrated near features, zero mismatches; the CMM reports were measured off the sealed solids with 1.5 micron noise. A battery of 17 wrong reconstructions rebuilt with the same engine all score 0: today's state with no rollback, today's state patched with the CMM-visible fixes only, DPI, EXT, H3 wear or D7 wear not rolled back, the G56 shift missed, today's T6, the old T6 with H6 left at today's value, OP20 turned over about X as the setup sheet says, and six control semantics misreadings (M98 own local level, mirror without arc reversal, H taken from the loaded tool, G52 accumulating, vacant argument as zero, M99 restoring G90) plus the bull nose as a flat endmill. The one per part pass in it (old T6 with today's H6 on MNF-0610) is correct, since O1620 calls H5 there; that reading still fails BRG-1140 and LVR-2205. Four lazy submissions in cheat/ and an empty output score 0."""

"""as-machined STEP models: each submitted solid must match what the stored programs cut"""
import os
import sys

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import check_models  # noqa: E402

TRUTH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "truth")
PARTS = ["MNF-0610", "BRG-1140", "LVR-2205"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("part", PARTS)
def test_model_matches_machined_part(part):
    path = f"/app/models/{part}.step"
    assert os.path.isfile(path), f"{path} missing"
    try:
        msg = check_models.compare(path, os.path.join(TRUTH, f"{part}.step"))
    except check_models.Bad as e:
        pytest.fail(f"{part}: {e}")
    print(part, msg)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare a submitted STEP model with the sealed as-machined solid (OCCT via cadquery-ocp).

A model passes when, for some proper rotation of the 24 axis-aligned ones (no mirroring) and the
translation that lines up the bounding boxes:
  * it is one valid closed solid;
  * |V - V_true| <= 1e-4 * V_true and vol(A xor T) <= 2e-4 * V_true;
  * every sampled point of either surface lies within 0.02 mm of the other solid.
"""
import itertools
import math
import sys

from OCP.Bnd import Bnd_Box
from OCP.BRep import BRep_Tool
from OCP.BRepAdaptor import BRepAdaptor_Surface
from OCP.BRepAlgoAPI import BRepAlgoAPI_Cut
from OCP.BRepBndLib import BRepBndLib
from OCP.BRepBuilderAPI import BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex, BRepBuilderAPI_Transform
from OCP.BRepCheck import BRepCheck_Analyzer
from OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier
from OCP.BRepExtrema import BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape
from OCP.BRep import BRep_Builder
from OCP.TopoDS import TopoDS_Compound
from OCP.BRepGProp import BRepGProp
from OCP.BRepTools import BRepTools
from OCP.GProp import GProp_GProps
from OCP.gp import gp_Mat, gp_Pnt, gp_Trsf, gp_Vec, gp_XYZ, gp_GTrsf
from OCP.IFSelect import IFSelect_RetDone
from OCP.STEPControl import STEPControl_Reader
from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_FACE, TopAbs_SOLID, TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_SHELL
from OCP.TopExp import TopExp_Explorer
from OCP.TopoDS import TopoDS

VOL_REL, XOR_REL, DEV = 1e-4, 2e-4, 0.02


class Bad(Exception):
    pass


def read_step(path):
    r = STEPControl_Reader()
    if r.ReadFile(path) != IFSelect_RetDone:
        raise Bad(f"{path}: not a readable STEP file")
    r.TransferRoots()
    shape = r.OneShape()
    solids = []
    ex = TopExp_Explorer(shape, TopAbs_SOLID)
    while ex.More():
        solids.append(TopoDS.Solid_s(ex.Current()))
        ex.Next()
    if len(solids) != 1:
        raise Bad(f"{path}: expected exactly one solid, found {len(solids)}")
    s = solids[0]
    if not BRepCheck_Analyzer(s).IsValid():
        raise Bad(f"{path}: solid is not valid (BRepCheck)")
    return s


def volume(s):
    p = GProp_GProps()
    BRepGProp.VolumeProperties_s(s, p)
    return p.Mass()


def bbox(s):
    b = Bnd_Box()
    b.SetGap(0.0)
    BRepBndLib.AddOptimal_s(s, b, False, False)
    return b.Get()


def rotations():
    """the 24 proper rotations that map coordinate axes to coordinate axes"""
    out = []
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(3)):
        for signs in itertools.product((1, -1), repeat=3):
            m = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
            for r in range(3):
                m[r][perm[r]] = signs[r]
            det = (m[0][0] * (m[1][1] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][1])
                   - m[0][1] * (m[1][0] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][0])
                   + m[0][2] * (m[1][0] * m[2][1] - m[1][1] * m[2][0]))
            if det == 1:
                out.append(m)
    return out


def transformed(s, m, t):
    tr = gp_Trsf()
    tr.SetValues(m[0][0], m[0][1], m[0][2], t[0],
                 m[1][0], m[1][1], m[1][2], t[1],
                 m[2][0], m[2][1], m[2][2], t[2])
    return BRepBuilderAPI_Transform(s, tr, True).Shape()


def surface_points(s, n=5):
    pts = []
    ex = TopExp_Explorer(s, TopAbs_FACE)
    while ex.More():
        f = TopoDS.Face_s(ex.Current())
        ad = BRepAdaptor_Surface(f)
        u0, u1, v0, v1 = ad.FirstUParameter(), ad.LastUParameter(), ad.FirstVParameter(), ad.LastVParameter()
        from OCP.BRepTopAdaptor import BRepTopAdaptor_FClass2d
        from OCP.gp import gp_Pnt2d
        from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_OUT
        cls = BRepTopAdaptor_FClass2d(f, 1e-7)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                u = u0 + (u1 - u0) * (i + 0.5) / n
                v = v0 + (v1 - v0) * (j + 0.5) / n
                if cls.Perform(gp_Pnt2d(u, v)) == TopAbs_OUT:
                    continue
                pts.append(ad.Value(u, v))
        ex.Next()
    return pts


def boundary(shape):
    """the faces of a solid as one compound: distances are then measured to the surface, so a sample
    point lying inside the other solid (extra material removed there) still counts as off-surface"""
    comp = TopoDS_Compound()
    bld = BRep_Builder()
    bld.MakeCompound(comp)
    ex = TopExp_Explorer(shape, TopAbs_FACE)
    while ex.More():
        bld.Add(comp, ex.Current())
        ex.Next()
    return comp


def max_dev(points, shape):
    worst = 0.0
    skin = boundary(shape)
    for p in points:
        d = BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape(BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex(p).Vertex(), skin)
        d.Perform()
        worst = max(worst, d.Value())
        if worst > 10 * DEV:
            break
    return worst


def compare(model_path, truth_path):
    T = read_step(truth_path)
    A = read_step(model_path)
    vt, va = volume(T), volume(A)
    if not (math.isfinite(va) and math.isfinite(vt)) or vt <= 0 or va <= 0:
        raise Bad(f"volume is not a finite positive number ({va!r} mm3)")
    if abs(va - vt) > VOL_REL * vt:
        raise Bad(f"volume {va:.3f} mm3, the programs leave {vt:.3f} mm3")
    tb = bbox(T)
    tdim = (tb[3] - tb[0], tb[4] - tb[1], tb[5] - tb[2])
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in tb):
        raise Bad("reference bounding box is not finite")
    best = None
    for m in rotations():
        R = transformed(A, m, (0, 0, 0))
        rb = bbox(R)
        rdim = (rb[3] - rb[0], rb[4] - rb[1], rb[5] - rb[2])
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in rb):
            continue
        if max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(rdim, tdim)) > 0.05:
            continue
        t = (tb[0] - rb[0], tb[1] - rb[1], tb[2] - rb[2])
        P = transformed(A, m, t)
        x1, x2 = BRepAlgoAPI_Cut(P, T), BRepAlgoAPI_Cut(T, P)
        xor = volume(x1.Shape()) + volume(x2.Shape())
        if not math.isfinite(xor):
            continue
        if best is None or xor < best[0]:
            best = (xor, P)
    if best is None:
        raise Bad("overall size does not match the machined part in any orientation")
    xor, P = best
    if xor > XOR_REL * vt:
        raise Bad(f"geometry differs from the machined part (non-overlapping volume {xor:.2f} mm3)")
    d1 = max_dev(surface_points(T), P)
    d2 = max_dev(surface_points(P), T)
    if not (math.isfinite(d1) and math.isfinite(d2)):
        raise Bad("surface deviation is not finite")
    if max(d1, d2) > DEV:
        raise Bad(f"surface deviates from the machined part by {max(d1, d2):.3f} mm")
    return f"V={va:.2f} xor={xor:.4f} dev={max(d1, d2):.5f}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        print("PASS", compare(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))
    except Bad as e:
        print("FAIL", e)
        sys.exit(1)

14	from OCP.Bnd import Bnd_Box

16	from OCP.BRepAdaptor import BRepAdaptor_Surface
17	from OCP.BRepAlgoAPI import BRepAlgoAPI_Cut
18	from OCP.BRepBndLib import BRepBndLib
19	from OCP.BRepBuilderAPI import BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex, BRepBuilderAPI_Transform
20	from OCP.BRepCheck import BRepCheck_Analyzer
21	from OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier
22	from OCP.BRepExtrema import BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape
23	from OCP.BRep import BRep_Builder
24	from OCP.TopoDS import TopoDS_Compound
25	from OCP.BRepGProp import BRepGProp
26	from OCP.BRepTools import BRepTools
27	from OCP.GProp import GProp_GProps
28	from OCP.gp import gp_Mat, gp_Pnt, gp_Trsf, gp_Vec, gp_XYZ, gp_GTrsf
29	from OCP.IFSelect import IFSelect_RetDone
30	from OCP.STEPControl import STEPControl_Reader
31	from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_FACE, TopAbs_SOLID, TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_SHELL
32	from OCP.TopExp import TopExp_Explorer
33	from OCP.TopoDS import TopoDS
34	
35	VOL_REL, XOR_REL, DEV = 1e-4, 2e-4, 0.02
36	
37	
38	class Bad(Exception):
39	    pass
40	
41	
42	def read_step(path):
43	    r = STEPControl_Reader()
44	    if r.ReadFile(path) != IFSelect_RetDone:
45	        raise Bad(f"{path}: not a readable STEP file")
46	    r.TransferRoots()
47	    shape = r.OneShape()
48	    solids = []
49	    ex = TopExp_Explorer(shape, TopAbs_SOLID)
50	    while ex.More():
51	        solids.append(TopoDS.Solid_s(ex.Current()))
52	        ex.Next()
53	    if len(solids) != 1:
54	        raise Bad(f"{path}: expected exactly one solid, found {len(solids)}")
55	    s = solids[0]
56	    if not BRepCheck_Analyzer(s).IsValid():
57	        raise Bad(f"{path}: solid is not valid (BRepCheck)")
58	    return s
59	
60	
61	def volume(s):
62	    p = GProp_GProps()
63	    BRepGProp.VolumeProperties_s(s, p)
64	    return p.Mass()
65	
66	
67	def bbox(s):
68	    b = Bnd_Box()
69	    b.SetGap(0.0)
70	    BRepBndLib.AddOptimal_s(s, b, False, False)
71	    return b.Get()
72	
73	
74	def rotations():
75	    """the 24 proper rotations that map coordinate axes to coordinate axes"""
76	    out = []
77	    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(3)):
78	        for signs in itertools.product((1, -1), repeat=3):
79	            m = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
80	            for r in range(3):
81	                m[r][perm[r]] = signs[r]
82	            det = (m[0][0] * (m[1][1] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][1])
83	                   - m[0][1] * (m[1][0] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][0])
84	                   + m[0][2] * (m[1][0] * m[2][1] - m[1][1] * m[2][0]))
85	            if det == 1:
86	                out.append(m)
87	    return out
88	
89	
90	def transformed(s, m, t):
91	    tr = gp_Trsf()
92	    tr.SetValues(m[0][0], m[0][1], m[0][2], t[0],
93	                 m[1][0], m[1][1], m[1][2], t[1],
94	                 m[2][0], m[2][1], m[2][2], t[2])
95	    return BRepBuilderAPI_Transform(s, tr, True).Shape()
96	
97	
98	def surface_points(s, n=5):
99	    pts = []
100	    ex = TopExp_Explorer(s, TopAbs_FACE)
101	    while ex.More():
102	        f = TopoDS.Face_s(ex.Current())
103	        ad = BRepAdaptor_Surface(f)
104	        u0, u1, v0, v1 = ad.FirstUParameter(), ad.LastUParameter(), ad.FirstVParameter(), ad.LastVParameter()
105	        from OCP.BRepTopAdaptor import BRepTopAdaptor_FClass2d
106	        from OCP.gp import gp_Pnt2d
107	        from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_OUT
108	        cls = BRepTopAdaptor_FClass2d(f, 1e-7)
109	        for i in range(n):
110	            for j in range(n):
111	                u = u0 + (u1 - u0) * (i + 0.5) / n
112	                v = v0 + (v1 - v0) * (j + 0.5) / n
113	                if cls.Perform(gp_Pnt2d(u, v)) == TopAbs_OUT:
114	                    continue
115	                pts.append(ad.Value(u, v))
116	        ex.Next()
117	    return pts
118	
119	
120	def boundary(shape):
121	    """the faces of a solid as one compound: distances are then measured to the surface, so a sample
122	    point lying inside the other solid (extra material removed there) still counts as off-surface"""
123	    comp = TopoDS_Compound()
124	    bld = BRep_Builder()
125	    bld.MakeCompound(comp)
126	    ex = TopExp_Explorer(shape, TopAbs_FACE)
127	    while ex.More():
128	        bld.Add(comp, ex.Current())
129	        ex.Next()
130	    return comp
131	
132	
133	def max_dev(points, shape):
134	    worst = 0.0
135	    skin = boundary(shape)
136	    for p in points:
137	        d = BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape(BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex(p).Vertex(), skin)
138	        d.Perform()
139	        worst = max(worst, d.Value())
140	        if worst > 10 * DEV:
141	            break
142	    return worst
143	
144	
145	def compare(model_path, truth_path):
146	    T = read_step(truth_path)
147	    A = read_step(model_path)
148	    vt, va = volume(T), volume(A)
149	    if not (math.isfinite(va) and math.isfinite(vt)) or vt <= 0 or va <= 0:
150	        raise Bad(f"volume is not a finite positive number ({va!r} mm3)")
151	    if abs(va - vt) > VOL_REL * vt:
152	        raise Bad(f"volume {va:.3f} mm3, the programs leave {vt:.3f} mm3")
153	    tb = bbox(T)
154	    tdim = (tb[3] - tb[0], tb[4] - tb[1], tb[5] - tb[2])
155	    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in tb):
156	        raise Bad("reference bounding box is not finite")
157	    best = None
158	    for m in rotations():
159	        R = transformed(A, m, (0, 0, 0))
160	        rb = bbox(R)
161	        rdim = (rb[3] - rb[0], rb[4] - rb[1], rb[5] - rb[2])
162	        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in rb):
163	            continue
164	        if max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(rdim, tdim)) > 0.05:
165	            continue
166	        t = (tb[0] - rb[0], tb[1] - rb[1], tb[2] - rb[2])
167	        P = transformed(A, m, t)
168	        x1, x2 = BRepAlgoAPI_Cut(P, T), BRepAlgoAPI_Cut(T, P)
169	        xor = volume(x1.Shape()) + volume(x2.Shape())
170	        if not math.isfinite(xor):
171	            continue
172	        if best is None or xor < best[0]:
173	            best = (xor, P)
174	    if best is None:
175	        raise Bad("overall size does not match the machined part in any orientation")
176	    xor, P = best
177	    if xor > XOR_REL * vt:
178	        raise Bad(f"geometry differs from the machined part (non-overlapping volume {xor:.2f} mm3)")
179	    d1 = max_dev(surface_points(T), P)
180	    d2 = max_dev(surface_points(P), T)
181	    if not (math.isfinite(d1) and math.isfinite(d2)):
182	        raise Bad("surface deviation is not finite")
183	    if max(d1, d2) > DEV:
184	        raise Bad(f"surface deviates from the machined part by {max(d1, d2):.3f} mm")
185	    return f"V={va:.2f} xor={xor:.4f} dev={max(d1, d2):.5f}"
186	
187	
188	if __name__ == "__main__":
189	    try:
190	        print("PASS", compare(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))
191	    except Bad as e:
192	        print("FAIL", e)
193	        sys.exit(1)

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""As-machined STEP models of the lot that ran 2026-09-18.
3	
4	1. roll today's control backup back to the lot date with the operation history (OPRT-HIS.TXT);
5	2. what the history cannot reach (it starts 09-24) is settled against the CMM reports of that lot:
6	   for each open question (which T6 was in the spindle, how MNF-0610 OP20 was loaded, any work
7	   offset moved) machine the part, measure it like the QC program does, compare, and fit work
8	   offset shifts from the positional residuals;
9	3. keep the one reading that reproduces every reported characteristic within CMM noise, export.
10	
11	usage: models.py <cnc dir> <shop dir> <qc dir> <out dir>
12	"""
13	import glob
14	import sys
15	
16	import cadquery as cq
17	
18	import cmm
19	import history
20	import parts
21	
22	LOT = "2026/09/18 23:59:59"
23	WCS = {"MNF-0610": 2, "BRG-1140": 3, "LVR-2205": 4}       # last setup's work offset (G55/G56/G57)
24	FIT_TOL = 0.01     # three serials, sigma ~1.5 um: anything real sits well inside this
25	
26	
27	def measured(qc):
28	    """average of the serials per characteristic; None where a report says not found"""
29	    acc = {}
30	    for path in sorted(glob.glob(f"{qc}/*.TXT")):
31	        part, res = cmm.read_report(path)
32	        for name, vals in res.items():
33	            acc.setdefault(part, {}).setdefault(name, []).append(vals)
34	    out = {}
35	    for part, chars in acc.items():
36	        out[part] = {}
37	        for name, runs in chars.items():
38	            if any(r is None for r in runs):
39	                out[part][name] = None
40	                continue
41	            out[part][name] = {ax: sum(r[ax] for r in runs) / len(runs) for ax in runs[0]}
42	    return out
43	
44	
45	def compare(part, solid, axis, meas):
46	    """residuals (measured - model) per characteristic axis; missing features count as huge"""
47	    model = cmm.inspect(part, parts.to_print(part, solid, axis))
48	    res = {}
49	    for name, m in meas.items():
50	        s = model.get(name)
51	        if (m is None) != (s is None):
52	            res[(name, "found")] = 99.0
53	            continue
54	        if m is None:
55	            continue
56	        for ax, v in m.items():
57	            res[(name, ax)] = v - s[ax]
58	    return res
59	
60	
61	def worst(res):
62	    return max(abs(v) for v in res.values()) if res else 0.0
63	
64	
65	def shift_of(res):
66	    xs = [v for (n, ax), v in res.items() if ax == "X"]
67	    ys = [v for (n, ax), v in res.items() if ax == "Y"]
68	    return (round(sum(xs) / len(xs), 3) if xs else 0.0, round(sum(ys) / len(ys), 3) if ys else 0.0)
69	
70	
71	def settle(part, state, old_t6, axis, meas):
72	    """machine, compare, and if the residuals are a common XY offset, move that work offset"""
73	    tools, lengths = parts.crib(old_t6)
74	    st = dict(state, work={k: list(v) for k, v in state["work"].items()},
75	              off={k: dict(v) for k, v in state["off"].items()})
76	    if old_t6:      # H6 was re-entered from the presetter on 09-22, so it held the old drill
77	        st["off"]["Hg"][6] = parts.OLD_T6[1]
78	    s = parts.build(part, st, tools, lengths, axis)
79	    res = compare(part, s, axis, meas)
80	    if worst(res) > FIT_TOL and all(v < 99 for v in res.values()):
81	        dx, dy = shift_of(res)
82	        st["work"][WCS[part]][0] += dx
83	        st["work"][WCS[part]][1] += dy
84	        s = parts.build(part, st, tools, lengths, axis)
85	        res = compare(part, s, axis, meas)
86	        print(f"  {part}: work offset P{WCS[part]} moved by X{dx:+.3f} Y{dy:+.3f}", flush=True)
87	    return s, res
88	
89	
90	def main():
91	    cnc, shop, qc, out = sys.argv[1:5]
92	    today = history.load_state(cnc)
93	    state, undone, edits = history.roll_back(today, f"{cnc}/OPRT-HIS.TXT", LOT)
94	    print(f"history reaches back to {history.earliest(cnc + '/OPRT-HIS.TXT')}; undid {len(undone)} changes")
95	    for stamp, what in undone:
96	        print("  ", stamp, what)
97	    used = {1140, 1141, 1610, 1611, 1620, 1621, 2205, 2206, 9010, 9011, 9020}
98	    if used & set(edits):
99	        raise SystemExit(f"programs {used & set(edits)} were edited after the lot: cannot reconstruct")
100	    meas = measured(qc)
101	    found = {}
102	    for old_t6 in (False, True):            # TOOL-LIST: T6 was swapped on 09-22
103	        found = {}
104	        for part in ("BRG-1140", "LVR-2205", "MNF-0610"):
105	            for axis in (("X", "Y") if part == "MNF-0610" else ("X",)):
106	                s, res = settle(part, state, old_t6, axis, meas[part])
107	                print(f"T6 {'old' if old_t6 else 'current'} {part} OP20 axis {axis}: worst residual {worst(res):.4f}",
108	                      flush=True)
109	                if worst(res) <= FIT_TOL:
110	                    found[part] = s
111	                    break
112	            if part not in found:
113	                break
114	        if len(found) == 3:
115	            break
116	    if len(found) != 3:
117	        raise SystemExit("no reading of the lot reproduces the CMM reports")
118	    for name, s in found.items():
119	        cq.exporters.export(cq.Workplane().add(s), f"{out}/{name}.step")
120	        print(name, round(s.Volume(), 4), len(s.Faces()), "faces")
121	
122	
123	if __name__ == "__main__":
124	    main()
125

46	    """residuals (measured - model) per characteristic axis; missing features count as huge"""
47	    model = cmm.inspect(part, parts.to_print(part, solid, axis))
48	    res = {}
49	    for name, m in meas.items():
50	        s = model.get(name)
51	        if (m is None) != (s is None):
52	            res[(name, "found")] = 99.0
53	            continue
54	        if m is None:
55	            continue
56	        for ax, v in m.items():
57	            res[(name, ax)] = v - s[ax]
58	    return res
59	
60	
61	def worst(res):
62	    return max(abs(v) for v in res.values()) if res else 0.0
63	
64	
65	def shift_of(res):
66	    xs = [v for (n, ax), v in res.items() if ax == "X"]
67	    ys = [v for (n, ax), v in res.items() if ax == "Y"]
68	    return (round(sum(xs) / len(xs), 3) if xs else 0.0, round(sum(ys) / len(ys), 3) if ys else 0.0)

71	def settle(part, state, old_t6, axis, meas):
72	    """machine, compare, and if the residuals are a common XY offset, move that work offset"""
73	    tools, lengths = parts.crib(old_t6)
74	    st = dict(state, work={k: list(v) for k, v in state["work"].items()},
75	              off={k: dict(v) for k, v in state["off"].items()})
76	    if old_t6:      # H6 was re-entered from the presetter on 09-22, so it held the old drill

79	    res = compare(part, s, axis, meas)

82	        st["work"][WCS[part]][0] += dx
83	        st["work"][WCS[part]][1] += dy
84	        s = parts.build(part, st, tools, lengths, axis)
85	        res = compare(part, s, axis, meas)
86	        print(f"  {part}: work offset P{WCS[part]} moved by X{dx:+.3f} Y{dy:+.3f}", flush=True)
87	    return s, res
88	
89	
90	def main():
91	    cnc, shop, qc, out = sys.argv[1:5]
92	    today = history.load_state(cnc)
93	    state, undone, edits = history.roll_back(today, f"{cnc}/OPRT-HIS.TXT", LOT)
94	    print(f"history reaches back to {history.earliest(cnc + '/OPRT-HIS.TXT')}; undid {len(undone)} changes")
95	    for stamp, what in undone:
96	        print("  ", stamp, what)
97	    used = {1140, 1141, 1610, 1611, 1620, 1621, 2205, 2206, 9010, 9011, 9020}
98	    if used & set(edits):
99	        raise SystemExit(f"programs {used & set(edits)} were edited after the lot: cannot reconstruct")
100	    meas = measured(qc)
101	    found = {}
102	    for old_t6 in (False, True):            # TOOL-LIST: T6 was swapped on 09-22
103	        found = {}
104	        for part in ("BRG-1140", "LVR-2205", "MNF-0610"):
105	            for axis in (("X", "Y") if part == "MNF-0610" else ("X",)):
106	                s, res = settle(part, state, old_t6, axis, meas[part])
107	                print(f"T6 {'old' if old_t6 else 'current'} {part} OP20 axis {axis}: worst residual {worst(res):.4f}",
108	                      flush=True)
109	                if worst(res) <= FIT_TOL:
110	                    found[part] = s
111	                    break
112	            if part not in found:
113	                break
114	        if len(found) == 3:
115	            break
116	    if len(found) != 3:
117	        raise SystemExit("no reading of the lot reproduces the CMM reports")
118	    for name, s in found.items():
119	        cq.exporters.export(cq.Workplane().add(s), f"{out}/{name}.step")
120	        print(name, round(s.Volume(), 4), len(s.Faces()), "faces")
121	
122	
123	if __name__ == "__main__":
124	    main()

2	"""roll the control backup back to a past date using the operation history export (OPRT-HIS.TXT).
3	every logged data change after the cut-off is undone (new value -> old value), newest first."""
4	import copy
5	import re
6	
7	import fanuc
8	
9	WORK_NO = {"EXT": 0, "G54": 1, "G55": 2, "G56": 3, "G57": 4, "G58": 5, "G59": 6}
10	
11	
12	def _norm(v):
13	    v = v.lstrip("P")
14	    if re.fullmatch(r"[01]{8}", v):
15	        return v
16	    return float(v)
17	
18	
19	def load_state(cnc):
20	    return {"progs": fanuc.load_programs(f"{cnc}/ALL-PROG.TXT"),
21	            "params": fanuc.read_params(f"{cnc}/CNC-PARA.TXT"),
22	            "off": fanuc.read_offsets(f"{cnc}/TOOLOFST.TXT"),
23	            "work": fanuc.read_work(f"{cnc}/EXT_WKZ.TXT")}
24	
25	
26	def events(path):
27	    out = []
28	    for line in open(path):
29	        m = re.match(r"\d{5}\s+(\d{4}/\d\d/\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d)\s+(.*\S)", line)
30	        if m:
31	            out.append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
32	    return out
33	
34	
35	def earliest(path):
36	    return min(t for t, _ in events(path))
37	
38	
39	def roll_back(state, path, before):
40	    """state as it was at `before` ("YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM:SS"), as far as the history reaches.
41	    returns (state, list of undone changes, list of program edits that cannot be undone)"""
42	    st = copy.deepcopy(state)
43	    undone, edits = [], []
44	    for stamp, what in sorted(events(path), reverse=True):
45	        if stamp <= before:
46	            break
47	        m = re.match(r"(WEAR|GEOM) OFFSET \((H|D)\)\s+NO\.(\d+)\s+(-?[\d.]+)\s+->\s+(-?[\d.]+)", what)
48	        if m:
49	            key = ("H" if m.group(2) == "H" else "D") + ("w" if m.group(1) == "WEAR" else "g")
50	            no, old, new = int(m.group(3)), float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5))
51	            if abs(st["off"][key].get(no, 0.0) - new) > 1e-9:
52	                raise ValueError(f"history does not chain at {stamp}: {what}")
53	            st["off"][key][no] = old
54	            undone.append((stamp, what))
55	            continue
56	        m = re.match(r"WORK OFFSET\s+(\w+)\s+([XYZ])\s+(-?[\d.]+)\s+->\s+(-?[\d.]+)", what)
57	        if m:
58	            no, ax = WORK_NO[m.group(1)], "XYZ".index(m.group(2))
59	            old, new = float(m.group(3)), float(m.group(4))
60	            if abs(st["work"][no][ax] - new) > 1e-9:
61	                raise ValueError(f"history does not chain at {stamp}: {what}")
62	            st["work"][no][ax] = old
63	            undone.append((stamp, what))
64	            continue
65	        m = re.match(r"PARAMETER\s+NO\.(\d+)\s+(\S+)\s+->\s+(\S+)", what)
66	        if m:
67	            no, old, new = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2), m.group(3)
68	            if _norm(st["params"].get(no, "")) != _norm(new):
69	                raise ValueError(f"history does not chain at {stamp}: {what}")
70	            st["params"][no] = "P" + old
71	            undone.append((stamp, what))
72	            continue
73	        m = re.match(r"PROGRAM EDIT\s+O(\d+)", what)
74	        if m:
75	            edits.append(int(m.group(1)))
76	    return st, undone, edits

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Forward model: one part machined on a given control state with a given tool crib and setup."""
3	import cadquery as cq
4	
5	import cut
6	import fanuc
7	
8	# /app/shop/TOOL-LIST.TXT (as of today)
9	TOOLS = {
10	    1: cut.Tool("flat", 50.0),
11	    2: cut.Tool("flat", 16.0),
12	    3: cut.Tool("flat", 10.0),
13	    4: cut.Tool("cone", 12.0, point=90.0),
14	    5: cut.Tool("cone", 6.8, point=118.0),
15	    6: cut.Tool("cone", 6.6, point=140.0),
16	    7: cut.Tool("flat", 12.0),
17	    8: cut.Tool("cone", 12.0, point=90.0, tip_flat=2.0),
18	    9: cut.Tool("bull", 8.0, corner=1.0),
19	    10: cut.Tool("flat", 11.0),
20	}
21	LENGTH = {1: 98.412, 2: 110.250, 3: 102.775, 4: 95.300, 5: 124.640, 6: 121.115, 7: 108.880,
22	          8: 101.505, 9: 99.730, 10: 96.210}
23	# the T6 that came out on 09-22 (TOOL-LIST note)
24	OLD_T6 = (cut.Tool("cone", 6.8, point=118.0), 126.880)
25	
26	# /app/shop/VISE-SETUP.TXT
27	STOP_X, JAW_Y, PAR_Z = -612.0, -208.0, -455.0
28	
29	
30	def block(dx, dy, dz):
31	    """stock square in the vise: left end on the stop, back on the fixed jaw, bottom on parallels"""
32	    return cq.Solid.makeBox(dx, dy, dz, cq.Vector(STOP_X, JAW_Y - dy, PAR_Z))
33	
34	
35	def _walls(part, contact):
36	    bb = part.BoundingBox()
37	    slab = cq.Solid.makeBox(bb.xlen + 20, bb.ylen + 20, contact + 5,
38	                            cq.Vector(bb.xmin - 10, bb.ymin - 10, bb.zmax - contact))
39	    return bb, part.intersect(slab).BoundingBox()
40	
41	
42	def turn_over(part, axis="X", contact=15.0):
43	    """OP20 load: finished top down on the parallels, jaw and stop on the profiled walls within
44	    `contact` of the top. axis X (setup sheet): OP10 front face to the jaw, left end to the stop.
45	    axis Y: OP10 back face stays on the jaw, OP10 right end goes to the stop."""
46	    bb, wall = _walls(part, contact)
47	    if axis == "X":     # (x, y, z) -> (x, -y, -z)
48	        turned = part.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0), 180)
49	        return turned.translate(cq.Vector(STOP_X - wall.xmin, JAW_Y + wall.ymin, PAR_Z + bb.zmax))
50	    turned = part.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(0, 1, 0), 180)    # (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z)
51	    return turned.translate(cq.Vector(STOP_X + wall.xmax, JAW_Y - wall.ymax, PAR_Z + bb.zmax))
52	
53	
54	def to_print(part, solid, axis="X"):
55	    """put a finished part in print orientation (OP10 top up, OP10 front toward -Y)"""
56	    if part != "MNF-0610":
57	        return solid
58	    if axis == "X":
59	        return solid.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0), 180)
60	    return solid.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(0, 1, 0), 180)
61	
62	
63	def machine(stock, moves, tools, check=False):
64	    out = cut.cut(stock, cut.sweeps(moves, tools))
65	    if check:
66	        cut.rapid_hits(moves, tools, out)
67	    return out
68	
69	
70	def single(solid):
71	    solids = [s for s in solid.Solids() if abs(s.Volume()) > 1e-6]   # drop zero volume BOP debris
72	    if len(solids) != 1:
73	        raise RuntimeError(f"expected one solid, got {len(solids)}")
74	    if not solids[0].isValid():
75	        raise RuntimeError("machined solid is not valid")
76	    s = solids[0].clean()
77	    if not s.isValid():
78	        raise RuntimeError("cleaned solid is not valid")
79	    return s
80	
81	
82	def build(part, cnc, tools=None, lengths=None, axis="X", quirks=(), check=False):
83	    """the finished part, in its last setup's machine frame"""
84	    tools = tools or TOOLS
85	    lengths = lengths or LENGTH
86	    if part == "MNF-0610":
87	        op10, op20 = fanuc.run_part(cnc, [1610, 1620], lengths, quirks)
88	        p = single(machine(block(124.0, 84.0, 31.0), op10, tools, check))
89	        p = turn_over(p, axis)
90	        return single(machine(p, op20, tools, check))
91	    if part == "BRG-1140":
92	        (b,) = fanuc.run_part(cnc, [1140], lengths, quirks)
93	        return single(machine(block(90.0, 60.0, 40.0), b, tools, check))
94	    (c,) = fanuc.run_part(cnc, [2205], lengths, quirks)
95	    return single(machine(block(110.0, 45.0, 20.0), c, tools, check))
96	
97	
98	def crib(old_t6):
99	    tools, lengths = dict(TOOLS), dict(LENGTH)
100	    if old_t6:
101	        tools[6], lengths[6] = OLD_T6
102	    return tools, lengths
103

9	TOOLS = {

13	    4: cut.Tool("cone", 12.0, point=90.0),

15	    6: cut.Tool("cone", 6.6, point=140.0),
16	    7: cut.Tool("flat", 12.0),
17	    8: cut.Tool("cone", 12.0, point=90.0, tip_flat=2.0),
18	    9: cut.Tool("bull", 8.0, corner=1.0),

22	          8: 101.505, 9: 99.730, 10: 96.210}

30	def block(dx, dy, dz):
31	    """stock square in the vise: left end on the stop, back on the fixed jaw, bottom on parallels"""
32	    return cq.Solid.makeBox(dx, dy, dz, cq.Vector(STOP_X, JAW_Y - dy, PAR_Z))

35	def _walls(part, contact):
36	    bb = part.BoundingBox()
37	    slab = cq.Solid.makeBox(bb.xlen + 20, bb.ylen + 20, contact + 5,
38	                            cq.Vector(bb.xmin - 10, bb.ymin - 10, bb.zmax - contact))
39	    return bb, part.intersect(slab).BoundingBox()

42	def turn_over(part, axis="X", contact=15.0):
43	    """OP20 load: finished top down on the parallels, jaw and stop on the profiled walls within
44	    `contact` of the top. axis X (setup sheet): OP10 front face to the jaw, left end to the stop.
45	    axis Y: OP10 back face stays on the jaw, OP10 right end goes to the stop."""
46	    bb, wall = _walls(part, contact)
47	    if axis == "X":     # (x, y, z) -> (x, -y, -z)
48	        turned = part.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0), 180)
49	        return turned.translate(cq.Vector(STOP_X - wall.xmin, JAW_Y + wall.ymin, PAR_Z + bb.zmax))
50	    turned = part.rotate(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(0, 1, 0), 180)    # (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z)

70	def single(solid):
71	    solids = [s for s in solid.Solids() if abs(s.Volume()) > 1e-6]   # drop zero volume BOP debris
72	    if len(solids) != 1:
73	        raise RuntimeError(f"expected one solid, got {len(solids)}")
74	    if not solids[0].isValid():
75	        raise RuntimeError("machined solid is not valid")
76	    s = solids[0].clean()
77	    if not s.isValid():
78	        raise RuntimeError("cleaned solid is not valid")
79	    return s

82	def build(part, cnc, tools=None, lengths=None, axis="X", quirks=(), check=False):
83	    """the finished part, in its last setup's machine frame"""
84	    tools = tools or TOOLS
85	    lengths = lengths or LENGTH
86	    if part == "MNF-0610":
87	        op10, op20 = fanuc.run_part(cnc, [1610, 1620], lengths, quirks)
88	        p = single(machine(block(124.0, 84.0, 31.0), op10, tools, check))

92	        (b,) = fanuc.run_part(cnc, [1140], lengths, quirks)

95	    return single(machine(block(110.0, 45.0, 20.0), c, tools, check))
96	
97	
98	def crib(old_t6):
99	    tools, lengths = dict(TOOLS), dict(LENGTH)
100	    if old_t6:
101	        tools[6], lengths[6] = OLD_T6
102	    return tools, lengths

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Fanuc 0i-MF milling interpreter (the subset these programs use) -> tool tip moves in machine coords.
3	
4	Reads the control backups: ALL-PROG.TXT (punch), CNC-PARA.TXT, TOOLOFST.TXT (memory C, G10 L10-13),
5	EXT_WKZ.TXT (G10 L2 P0-6). Executes custom macro B and emits every move of the tool tip as the
6	machine makes it.
7	
8	Semantics followed (Fanuc 0i-MF operator/programming manual):
9	  * 3401#0 DPI = 0: an axis address written without a decimal point is in least input increment
10	    (0.001 mm). values coming from variables or [expressions] are taken as mm.
11	  * work coordinate = G54..G59 + EXT (P0) ; G52 sets (replaces) a local shift ; G10 L2 in G90
12	    overwrites the given axes only.
13	  * G43 Hn adds H geometry + H wear ; the tip ends at Zcmd + (Hn - real length of the loaded tool).
14	  * G41/G42 Dn use D geometry + D wear ; start-up / cancel type A (5003#0 SUP = 0).
15	  * I/J are always incremental from the arc start ; R < 0 -> arc over 180 deg.
16	  * G51.1 mirror: the path is mirrored, so arc direction and offset side reverse.
17	  * G68 rotates programmed coordinates (incremental ones too) about the given centre.
18	  * canned cycles: G91 R is from the initial level, Z from the R point, K repeats.
19	  * M98 runs in the caller's local variable level, G65 opens a new one with arguments.
20	  * a vacant variable in an address omits that address.
21	  * modal state (G90/G91, G52, cycle data ...) survives M99.
22	"""
23	import math
24	import re
25	
26	AXIS_SCALED = set("XYZIJRQ")    # addresses that read 1 = 0.001 mm without a decimal point (K here is a repeat count)
27	ARG_MAP = {"A": 1, "B": 2, "C": 3, "I": 4, "J": 5, "K": 6, "D": 7, "E": 8, "F": 9, "H": 11,
28	           "M": 13, "Q": 17, "R": 18, "S": 19, "T": 20, "U": 21, "V": 22, "W": 23,
29	           "X": 24, "Y": 25, "Z": 26}
30	EPS = 1e-9
31	
32	
33	class NCError(Exception):
34	    pass
35	
36	
37	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- backups
38	def read_params(path):
39	    p = {}
40	    for line in open(path):
41	        m = re.match(r"N(\d+)Q1(.*)", line.strip())
42	        if not m:
43	            continue
44	        p[int(m.group(1))] = m.group(2)
45	    return p
46	
47	
48	def param_bit(params, no, bit):
49	    v = params.get(no, "P00000000")
50	    m = re.match(r"P([01]{8})$", v)
51	    if not m:
52	        raise NCError(f"parameter {no} not bit type")
53	    return int(m.group(1)[7 - bit])
54	
55	
56	def read_g10(path):
57	    """returns list of dicts of the G10 lines"""
58	    out = []
59	    for line in open(path):
60	        line = line.strip()
61	        if not line.startswith("G10"):
62	            continue
63	        words = dict((a, float(v)) for a, v in re.findall(r"([A-Z])(-?[\d.]+)", line[3:]))
64	        out.append(words)
65	    return out
66	
67	
68	def read_offsets(path):
69	    off = {"Hg": {}, "Hw": {}, "Dg": {}, "Dw": {}}
70	    key = {10: "Hg", 11: "Hw", 12: "Dg", 13: "Dw"}
71	    for w in read_g10(path):
72	        off[key[int(w["L"])]][int(w["P"])] = w["R"]
73	    return off
74	
75	
76	def read_work(path):
77	    wk = {}
78	    for w in read_g10(path):
79	        wk[int(w["P"])] = [w.get("X", 0.0), w.get("Y", 0.0), w.get("Z", 0.0)]
80	    return wk
81	
82	
83	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- program store
84	def load_programs(path):
85	    text = open(path).read().replace("%", "")
86	    progs, cur = {}, None
87	    for raw in text.splitlines():
88	        line = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", "", raw).strip().upper()
89	        m = re.match(r"^O(\d+)", line)
90	        if m:
91	            cur = int(m.group(1))
92	            progs[cur] = []
93	            line = line[m.end():].strip()
94	        if cur is None or not line:
95	            continue
96	        progs[cur].append(line)
97	    return progs
98	
99	
100	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- expressions
101	TOK = re.compile(r"\s*(?:(\d+\.\d*|\.\d+|\d+)|(EQ|NE|GT|GE|LT|LE|AND|OR|XOR|MOD|SIN|COS|TAN|ATAN|SQRT|ABS|"
102	                 r"ROUND|FIX|FUP)|([#\[\]+\-*/]))")
103	
104	
105	def tokenize(s):
106	    out, i = [], 0
107	    s = s.strip()
108	    while i < len(s):
109	        m = TOK.match(s, i)
110	        if not m or m.end() == i:
111	            raise NCError(f"cannot tokenize {s[i:]!r}")
112	        out.append(m.group(1) or m.group(2) or m.group(3))
113	        i = m.end()
114	        while i < len(s) and s[i] == " ":
115	            i += 1
116	    return out
117	
118	
119	class Expr:
120	    def __init__(self, interp, toks):
121	        self.I, self.t, self.i = interp, toks, 0
122	
123	    def peek(self):
124	        return self.t[self.i] if self.i < len(self.t) else None
125	
126	    def take(self, want=None):
127	        tok = self.peek()
128	        if want is not None and tok != want:
129	            raise NCError(f"expected {want} got {tok} in {' '.join(self.t)}")
130	        self.i += 1
131	        return tok
132	
133	    def cond(self):
134	        a = self.expr()
135	        op = self.peek()
136	        if op in ("EQ", "NE", "GT", "GE", "LT", "LE"):
137	            self.take()
138	            b = self.expr()
139	            if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
140	                if a is None or b is None:
141	                    r = (a is None and b is None)
142	                else:
143	                    r = abs(a - b) < 1e-9
144	                return r if op == "EQ" else not r
145	            a = 0.0 if a is None else a
146	            b = 0.0 if b is None else b
147	            return {"GT": a > b, "GE": a >= b, "LT": a < b, "LE": a <= b}[op]
148	        return a
149	
150	    def expr(self):
151	        v = self.term()
152	        while self.peek() in ("+", "-", "OR", "XOR"):
153	            op = self.take()
154	            w = self.term()
155	            v, w = (v or 0.0), (w or 0.0)
156	            v = v + w if op == "+" else v - w if op == "-" else float(int(v) | int(w)) if op == "OR" \
157	                else float(int(v) ^ int(w))
158	        return v
159	
160	    def term(self):
161	        v = self.factor()
162	        while self.peek() in ("*", "/", "AND", "MOD"):
163	            op = self.take()
164	            w = self.factor()
165	            v, w = (v or 0.0), (w or 0.0)
166	            if op == "*":
167	                v = v * w
168	            elif op == "/":
169	                v = v / w
170	            elif op == "AND":
171	                v = float(int(v) & int(w))
172	            else:
173	                v = math.fmod(v, w)
174	        return v
175	
176	    def factor(self):
177	        tok = self.peek()
178	        if tok == "-":
179	            self.take()
180	            v = self.factor()
181	            return None if v is None else -v
182	        if tok == "+":
183	            self.take()
184	            return self.factor()
185	        if tok == "[":
186	            self.take()
187	            v = self.expr()
188	            self.take("]")
189	            return v
190	        if tok == "#":
191	            self.take()
192	            n = self.factor()
193	            return self.I.getvar(int(round(n)))
194	        if tok in ("SIN", "COS", "TAN", "SQRT", "ABS", "ROUND", "FIX", "FUP", "ATAN"):
195	            self.take()
196	            self.take("[")
197	            v = self.expr() or 0.0
198	            self.take("]")
199	            if tok == "SIN":
200	                return math.sin(math.radians(v))
201	            if tok == "COS":
202	                return math.cos(math.radians(v))
203	            if tok == "TAN":
204	                return math.tan(math.radians(v))
205	            if tok == "SQRT":
206	                return math.sqrt(v)
207	            if tok == "ABS":
208	                return abs(v)
209	            if tok == "ROUND":
210	                return math.floor(abs(v) + 0.5) * (1 if v >= 0 else -1)
211	            if tok == "FIX":
212	                return float(math.trunc(v))
213	            if tok == "FUP":
214	                return float(math.trunc(v) + (0 if v == math.trunc(v) else (1 if v > 0 else -1)))
215	            raise NCError("ATAN not supported")
216	        if tok is None:
217	            raise NCError("unexpected end of expression")
218	        self.take()
219	        return float(tok)
220	
221	
222	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- geometry helpers
223	def rot(v, deg):
224	    a = math.radians(deg)
225	    return (v[0] * math.cos(a) - v[1] * math.sin(a), v[0] * math.sin(a) + v[1] * math.cos(a))
226	
227	
228	def arc_center(p0, p1, r, ccw):
229	    """centre of the arc p0->p1 with radius R (negative: more than 180 deg)"""
230	    dx, dy = p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1]
231	    d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
232	    rr = abs(r)
233	    if d > 2 * rr + 1e-6:
234	        raise NCError("arc radius too small")
235	    h = math.sqrt(max(rr * rr - d * d / 4, 0.0))
236	    mx, my = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2
237	    nx, ny = -dy / d, dx / d          # left normal of chord
238	    # minor arc ccw -> centre on the left of the chord
239	    side = 1 if ccw else -1
240	    if r < 0:
241	        side = -side
242	    return (mx + side * h * nx, my + side * h * ny)
243	
244	
245	class Seg:
246	    """planar XY path element in program coordinates at height z"""
247	
248	    def __init__(self, kind, p0, p1, z, center=None, ccw=None):
249	        self.kind, self.p0, self.p1, self.z, self.c, self.ccw = kind, p0, p1, z, center, ccw
250	
251	    def radius(self):
252	        return math.hypot(self.p0[0] - self.c[0], self.p0[1] - self.c[1])
253	
254	    def tangent(self, at_end):
255	        if self.kind == "L":
256	            dx, dy = self.p1[0] - self.p0[0], self.p1[1] - self.p0[1]
257	            n = math.hypot(dx, dy)
258	            return (dx / n, dy / n)
259	        p = self.p1 if at_end else self.p0
260	        rx, ry = p[0] - self.c[0], p[1] - self.c[1]
261	        n = math.hypot(rx, ry)
262	        return (-ry / n, rx / n) if self.ccw else (ry / n, -rx / n)
263	
264	
265	def left(t):
266	    return (-t[1], t[0])
267	
268	
269	def offset_seg(s, d, side):
270	    """offset a segment by d to the left (side=+1) or right (side=-1)"""
271	    if s.kind == "L":
272	        n = left(s.tangent(False))
273	        o = (n[0] * d * side, n[1] * d * side)
274	        return Seg("L", (s.p0[0] + o[0], s.p0[1] + o[1]), (s.p1[0] + o[0], s.p1[1] + o[1]), s.z)
275	    r = s.radius()
276	    # left of a ccw arc is the inside
277	    inward = (1 if s.ccw else -1) * side
278	    nr = r - inward * d
279	    if nr <= 1e-9:
280	        raise NCError("offset arc radius not positive (interference)")
281	    def mv(p):
282	        rx, ry = p[0] - s.c[0], p[1] - s.c[1]
283	        k = nr / math.hypot(rx, ry)
284	        return (s.c[0] + rx * k, s.c[1] + ry * k)
285	    return Seg("A", mv(s.p0), mv(s.p1), s.z, s.c, s.ccw)
286	
287	
288	def intersect(a, b, near):
289	    """intersection of offset elements a and b (as infinite line / full circle) nearest to `near`"""
290	    pts = []
291	    if a.kind == "L" and b.kind == "L":
292	        d1 = (a.p1[0] - a.p0[0], a.p1[1] - a.p0[1])
293	        d2 = (b.p1[0] - b.p0[0], b.p1[1] - b.p0[1])
294	        den = d1[0] * d2[1] - d1[1] * d2[0]
295	        if abs(den) < 1e-12:
296	            return None
297	        t = ((b.p0[0] - a.p0[0]) * d2[1] - (b.p0[1] - a.p0[1]) * d2[0]) / den
298	        return (a.p0[0] + t * d1[0], a.p0[1] + t * d1[1])
299	    if a.kind == "A" and b.kind == "A":
300	        c1, r1, c2, r2 = a.c, a.radius(), b.c, b.radius()
301	        dx, dy = c2[0] - c1[0], c2[1] - c1[1]
302	        d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
303	        if d < 1e-12:
304	            return None
305	        x = (d * d + r1 * r1 - r2 * r2) / (2 * d)
306	        h2 = r1 * r1 - x * x
307	        if h2 < -1e-9:
308	            return None
309	        h = math.sqrt(max(h2, 0))
310	        bx, by = c1[0] + x * dx / d, c1[1] + x * dy / d
311	        pts = [(bx - h * dy / d, by + h * dx / d), (bx + h * dy / d, by - h * dx / d)]
312	    else:
313	        ln, ar = (a, b) if a.kind == "L" else (b, a)
314	        d = (ln.p1[0] - ln.p0[0], ln.p1[1] - ln.p0[1])
315	        n = math.hypot(*d)
316	        d = (d[0] / n, d[1] / n)
317	        f = (ln.p0[0] - ar.c[0], ln.p0[1] - ar.c[1])
318	        bq = f[0] * d[0] + f[1] * d[1]
319	        cq = f[0] ** 2 + f[1] ** 2 - ar.radius() ** 2
320	        disc = bq * bq - cq
321	        if disc < -1e-9:
322	            return None
323	        sq = math.sqrt(max(disc, 0))
324	        pts = [(ln.p0[0] + (-bq + s) * d[0], ln.p0[1] + (-bq + s) * d[1]) for s in (sq, -sq)]
325	    return min(pts, key=lambda p: math.hypot(p[0] - near[0], p[1] - near[1]))

328	def comp_path(start, segs, end, d, side):
329	    """type A start-up / cancel cutter compensation. returns list of Seg for the tool centre."""
330	    if d < 1e-12:
331	        out, cur = [], start
332	        for s in segs:
333	            out.append(s)
334	        return [Seg("L", start, segs[0].p0, segs[0].z)] + out + [Seg("L", segs[-1].p1, end, segs[-1].z)]
335	    offs = [offset_seg(s, d, side) for s in segs]
336	    # junctions
337	    pts_start = [o.p0 for o in offs]
338	    pts_end = [o.p1 for o in offs]
339	    path = []
340	    out_segs = [Seg(o.kind, o.p0, o.p1, o.z, o.c, o.ccw) for o in offs]
341	    inserts = {}
342	    for k in range(len(segs) - 1):
343	        t1 = segs[k].tangent(True)
344	        t2 = segs[k + 1].tangent(False)
345	        cross = t1[0] * t2[1] - t1[1] * t2[0]
346	        dot = t1[0] * t2[0] + t1[1] * t2[1]
347	        if abs(cross) < 1e-9 and dot > 0:
348	            continue                                   # tangent, offsets meet
349	        inner = cross * side > 0
350	        if inner:
351	            p = intersect(out_segs[k], out_segs[k + 1], segs[k].p1)
352	            if p is None:
353	                raise NCError("no intersection at inner corner")
354	            out_segs[k].p1 = p
355	            out_segs[k + 1].p0 = p
356	        else:
357	            corner = segs[k].p1
358	            inserts[k] = Seg("A", out_segs[k].p1, out_segs[k + 1].p0, segs[k].z, corner, side < 0)
359	    for k, s in enumerate(out_segs):
360	        path.append(s)
361	        if k in inserts:
362	            path.append(inserts[k])
363	    path.insert(0, Seg("L", start, out_segs[0].p0, segs[0].z))
364	    path.append(Seg("L", out_segs[-1].p1, end, segs[-1].z))
365	    return path

369	class Machine:

381	    def reset(self):
382	        self.locals = [dict()]

389	        self.h = None                    # H number

391	        self.next_tool = None

398	    # variables
399	    def getvar(self, n):
400	        if n == 0:
401	            return None
402	        if 1 <= n <= 33:
403	            return self.locals[-1].get(n)
404	        if 100 <= n <= 199 or 500 <= n <= 999:
405	            return self.common.get(n)
406	        for base, key in ((10000, "Hw"), (11000, "Hg"), (12000, "Dw"), (13000, "Dg")):
407	            if base < n <= base + 400:
408	                return self.off[key].get(n - base, 0.0)
409	        raise NCError(f"variable #{n} not supported")
410	
411	    def setvar(self, n, v):
412	        if 1 <= n <= 33:
413	            self.locals[-1][n] = v
414	        elif 100 <= n <= 199 or 500 <= n <= 999:
415	            self.common[n] = v
416	        else:
417	            raise NCError(f"cannot write #{n}")

419	    def ev(self, s):
420	        e = Expr(self, tokenize(s))
421	        v = e.expr()
422	        if e.i != len(e.t):
423	            raise NCError(f"trailing tokens in {s}")
424	        return v
425	
426	    def evcond(self, s):
427	        s = s.strip()
428	        if s.startswith("[") and s.endswith("]"):
429	            s = s[1:-1]
430	        e = Expr(self, tokenize(s))
431	        v = e.cond()
432	        if e.i != len(e.t):
433	            raise NCError(f"trailing tokens in {s}")
434	        return v

436	    # frames
437	    def to_machine(self, p):
438	        x, y, z = p
439	        if self.mirror[0] is not None:
440	            x = 2 * self.mirror[0] - x
441	        if self.mirror[1] is not None:
442	            y = 2 * self.mirror[1] - y
443	        if self.rot is not None:
444	            cx, cy, a = self.rot
445	            v = rot((x - cx, y - cy), a)
446	            x, y = cx + v[0], cy + v[1]
447	        w, e = self.work[self.wcs], self.work[0]
448	        if "no_ext" in self.quirks:
449	            e = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
450	        hv = self.hval() if self.h else None
451	        if hv is None:
452	            raise NCError("Z move without tool length offset")
453	        L = self.tool_len[self.tool]
454	        return (x + self.local_shift[0] + w[0] + e[0],
455	                y + self.local_shift[1] + w[1] + e[1],
456	                z + w[2] + e[2] + hv - L)
457	
458	    def hval(self):
459	        h = self.tool if "h_is_tool" in self.quirks else self.h
460	        hw = 0.0 if "no_hwear" in self.quirks else self.off["Hw"].get(h, 0.0)
461	        return self.off["Hg"].get(h, 0.0) + hw
462	
463	    def from_machine(self, m):
464	        w, e = self.work[self.wcs], self.work[0]
465	        if "no_ext" in self.quirks:
466	            e = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
467	        hv = self.hval()
468	        L = self.tool_len[self.tool]
469	        x = m[0] - self.local_shift[0] - w[0] - e[0]
470	        y = m[1] - self.local_shift[1] - w[1] - e[1]
471	        z = m[2] - w[2] - e[2] - hv + L
472	        if self.rot is not None:
473	            cx, cy, a = self.rot
474	            v = rot((x - cx, y - cy), -a)
475	            x, y = cx + v[0], cy + v[1]
476	        if self.mirror[0] is not None:
477	            x = 2 * self.mirror[0] - x
478	        if self.mirror[1] is not None:
479	            y = 2 * self.mirror[1] - y
480	        return [x, y, z]

482	    def refresh(self):
483	        """frame changed: the tool stays put, its programmed position is re-expressed"""
484	        if self.mpos is not None and self.pos is not None and None not in self.pos:
485	            self.pos = self.from_machine(self.mpos)

487	    def mirrored_odd(self):
488	        return (self.mirror[0] is not None) != (self.mirror[1] is not None)

490	    def emit(self, kind, p_new, arc=None):
491	        m_new = self.to_machine(p_new)
492	        if self.mpos is not None:
493	            a = None
494	            if arc is not None:
495	                c, ccw = arc
496	                cm = self.to_machine((c[0], c[1], p_new[2]))
497	                flip = self.mirrored_odd() and "mirror_keeps_arcs" not in self.quirks
498	                a = ((cm[0], cm[1]), ccw != flip)
499	            self.moves.append((kind, self.tool, self.mpos, m_new, a))

503	    # word parsing
504	    def words(self, line):
505	        out = []
506	        i = 0
507	        while i < len(line):
508	            c = line[i]
509	            if c == " ":
510	                i += 1
511	                continue
512	            if not c.isalpha():
513	                raise NCError(f"bad block {line!r}")
514	            i += 1
515	            j = i
516	            if j < len(line) and line[j] in "-+":
517	                j += 1
518	            if j < len(line) and line[j] == "[":
519	                depth = 0
520	                while True:
521	                    if line[j] == "[":
522	                        depth += 1
523	                    elif line[j] == "]":
524	                        depth -= 1
525	                        if depth == 0:
526	                            j += 1
527	                            break
528	                    j += 1
529	                raw = line[i:j]
530	                out.append((c, raw, "expr"))
531	            elif j < len(line) and line[j] == "#":
532	                j += 1
533	                if line[j] == "[":
534	                    depth = 0
535	                    while True:
536	                        if line[j] == "[":
537	                            depth += 1
538	                        elif line[j] == "]":
539	                            depth -= 1
540	                            if depth == 0:
541	                                j += 1
542	                                break
543	                        j += 1
544	                else:
545	                    while j < len(line) and line[j].isdigit():
546	                        j += 1
547	                out.append((c, line[i:j], "expr"))
548	            else:
549	                while j < len(line) and (line[j].isdigit() or line[j] == "."):
550	                    j += 1
551	                out.append((c, line[i:j], "num"))
552	            i = j
553	        return out
554	
555	    def value(self, addr, raw, kind):
556	        if kind == "expr":
557	            return self.ev(raw)
558	        v = float(raw)
559	        if addr in AXIS_SCALED and "." not in raw and self.dpi == 0:
560	            v *= 0.001
561	        return v

563	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ run
564	    def run(self, prog):
565	        stack = []          # (prog, pc, is_g65)
566	        cur, pc = prog, 0
567	        loops = {}
568	        steps = 0
569	        while True:
570	            steps += 1
571	            if steps > 200000:
572	                raise NCError("runaway")
573	            lines = self.progs[cur]
574	            if pc >= len(lines):
575	                raise NCError(f"fell off O{cur}")
576	            line = lines[pc]
577	            pc += 1
578	            m = re.match(r"^N(\d+)\s*", line)
579	            if m:
580	                line = line[m.end():]
581	            if not line:
582	                continue
583	            # ---------------- macro statements
584	            if line.startswith("#"):
585	                lhs, rhs = line.split("=", 1)
586	                n = int(round(self.ev(lhs[1:]))) if lhs[1] == "[" else int(lhs[1:])
587	                self.setvar(n, self.ev(rhs))
588	                continue
589	            if line.startswith("IF"):
590	                m = re.match(r"IF\s*(\[.*\])\s*GOTO\s*(\d+)$", line)
591	                if m:
592	                    if self.evcond(m.group(1)):
593	                        pc = self.find_label(cur, int(m.group(2)))
594	                    continue
595	                m = re.match(r"IF\s*(\[.*\])\s*THEN\s*#(\d+)\s*=(.*)$", line)
596	                if m:
597	                    if self.evcond(m.group(1)):
598	                        self.setvar(int(m.group(2)), self.ev(m.group(3)))
599	                    continue
600	                raise NCError(f"bad IF {line}")
601	            if line.startswith("GOTO"):
602	                pc = self.find_label(cur, int(line[4:]))
603	                continue
604	            if line.startswith("WHILE"):
605	                m = re.match(r"WHILE\s*(\[.*\])\s*DO(\d)$", line)
606	                if not self.evcond(m.group(1)):
607	                    pc = self.find_end(cur, pc, m.group(2))
608	                continue
609	            m = re.match(r"^END(\d)$", line)
610	            if m:
611	                pc = self.find_while(cur, pc - 1, m.group(1))
612	                continue
613	            # ---------------- NC block
614	            ws = self.words(line)
615	            gs = [self.value(a, r, k) for a, r, k in ws if a == "G"]
616	            mcodes = [int(self.value(a, r, k)) for a, r, k in ws if a == "M"]
617	            vals = {}
618	            for a, r, k in ws:
619	                if a in "GMN":
620	                    continue
621	                v = self.value(a, r, k)
622	                if v is None and "vacant_is_zero" in self.quirks:
623	                    v = 0.0
624	                if v is None:
625	                    continue      # vacant variable: address omitted
626	                vals[a] = v
627	            if 65 in [int(g) for g in gs]:
628	                for a, r, k in ws:
629	                    if a not in "GP" and k == "num" and "." not in r:
630	                        raise NCError(f"G65 argument without decimal point: {line}")
631	                args = {}
632	                for a, v in vals.items():
633	                    if a == "P":
634	                        continue
635	                    args[ARG_MAP[a]] = v
636	                stack.append((cur, pc, True))
637	                self.locals.append(args)
638	                cur, pc = int(vals["P"]), 0
639	                continue
640	            if 98 in mcodes:
641	                own = "m98_new_level" in self.quirks
642	                stack.append((cur, pc, own))
643	                if own:
644	                    self.locals.append(dict(self.locals[-1]))
645	                cur, pc = int(vals["P"]), 0
646	                continue
647	            if 99 in mcodes:
648	                cur, pc, g65 = stack.pop()
649	                if g65:
650	                    self.locals.pop()
651	                if "m99_restores_g90" in self.quirks:
652	                    self.g90 = True
653	                continue
654	            if 30 in mcodes:
655	                if self.comp:
656	                    raise NCError("M30 in compensation")
657	                return
658	            self.block(gs, mcodes, vals, line)
659	
660	    def find_label(self, prog, n):
661	        for i, l in enumerate(self.progs[prog]):
662	            if re.match(rf"^N0*{n}(?!\d)", l):
663	                return i
664	        raise NCError(f"N{n} not found in O{prog}")

666	    def find_end(self, prog, pc, k):
667	        for i in range(pc, len(self.progs[prog])):
668	            if re.match(rf"^(N\d+\s*)?END{k}$", self.progs[prog][i]):
669	                return i + 1
670	        raise NCError("END not found")

672	    def find_while(self, prog, pc, k):
673	        for i in range(pc, -1, -1):
674	            if re.search(rf"DO{k}$", self.progs[prog][i]):
675	                return i
676	        raise NCError("WHILE not found")

682	        new_comp = None
683	        for g in gi:

782	        axes = [a for a in "XYZ" if a in vals]
783	        if not axes and self.motion not in (2, 3) and new_comp is None:

837	                raise NCError("Z move inside compensation")
838	            if arc is None:

840	            else:

847	                raise NCError("cancel must be linear XY")

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Fanuc 0i-MF milling interpreter (the subset these programs use) -> tool tip moves in machine coords.
3	
4	Reads the control backups: ALL-PROG.TXT (punch), CNC-PARA.TXT, TOOLOFST.TXT (memory C, G10 L10-13),
5	EXT_WKZ.TXT (G10 L2 P0-6). Executes custom macro B and emits every move of the tool tip as the
6	machine makes it.
7	
8	Semantics followed (Fanuc 0i-MF operator/programming manual):
9	  * 3401#0 DPI = 0: an axis address written without a decimal point is in least input increment
10	    (0.001 mm). values coming from variables or [expressions] are taken as mm.
11	  * work coordinate = G54..G59 + EXT (P0) ; G52 sets (replaces) a local shift ; G10 L2 in G90
12	    overwrites the given axes only.
13	  * G43 Hn adds H geometry + H wear ; the tip ends at Zcmd + (Hn - real length of the loaded tool).
14	  * G41/G42 Dn use D geometry + D wear ; start-up / cancel type A (5003#0 SUP = 0).
15	  * I/J are always incremental from the arc start ; R < 0 -> arc over 180 deg.
16	  * G51.1 mirror: the path is mirrored, so arc direction and offset side reverse.
17	  * G68 rotates programmed coordinates (incremental ones too) about the given centre.
18	  * canned cycles: G91 R is from the initial level, Z from the R point, K repeats.
19	  * M98 runs in the caller's local variable level, G65 opens a new one with arguments.
20	  * a vacant variable in an address omits that address.
21	  * modal state (G90/G91, G52, cycle data ...) survives M99.
22	"""
23	import math
24	import re
25	
26	AXIS_SCALED = set("XYZIJRQ")    # addresses that read 1 = 0.001 mm without a decimal point (K here is a repeat count)
27	ARG_MAP = {"A": 1, "B": 2, "C": 3, "I": 4, "J": 5, "K": 6, "D": 7, "E": 8, "F": 9, "H": 11,
28	           "M": 13, "Q": 17, "R": 18, "S": 19, "T": 20, "U": 21, "V": 22, "W": 23,
29	           "X": 24, "Y": 25, "Z": 26}
30	EPS = 1e-9

39	    p = {}
40	    for line in open(path):
41	        m = re.match(r"N(\d+)Q1(.*)", line.strip())
42	        if not m:
43	            continue
44	        p[int(m.group(1))] = m.group(2)
45	    return p

64	        out.append(words)

84	def load_programs(path):
85	    text = open(path).read().replace("%", "")
86	    progs, cur = {}, None
87	    for raw in text.splitlines():
88	        line = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", "", raw).strip().upper()
89	        m = re.match(r"^O(\d+)", line)
90	        if m:
91	            cur = int(m.group(1))
92	            progs[cur] = []
93	            line = line[m.end():].strip()
94	        if cur is None or not line:
95	            continue
96	        progs[cur].append(line)
97	    return progs

100	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- expressions
101	TOK = re.compile(r"\s*(?:(\d+\.\d*|\.\d+|\d+)|(EQ|NE|GT|GE|LT|LE|AND|OR|XOR|MOD|SIN|COS|TAN|ATAN|SQRT|ABS|"
102	                 r"ROUND|FIX|FUP)|([#\[\]+\-*/]))")
103

105	def tokenize(s):
106	    out, i = [], 0
107	    s = s.strip()
108	    while i < len(s):
109	        m = TOK.match(s, i)
110	        if not m or m.end() == i:
111	            raise NCError(f"cannot tokenize {s[i:]!r}")
112	        out.append(m.group(1) or m.group(2) or m.group(3))
113	        i = m.end()
114	        while i < len(s) and s[i] == " ":
115	            i += 1
116	    return out

119	class Expr:
120	    def __init__(self, interp, toks):
121	        self.I, self.t, self.i = interp, toks, 0
122	
123	    def peek(self):
124	        return self.t[self.i] if self.i < len(self.t) else None
125	
126	    def take(self, want=None):
127	        tok = self.peek()
128	        if want is not None and tok != want:
129	            raise NCError(f"expected {want} got {tok} in {' '.join(self.t)}")
130	        self.i += 1
131	        return tok
132	
133	    def cond(self):
134	        a = self.expr()
135	        op = self.peek()
136	        if op in ("EQ", "NE", "GT", "GE", "LT", "LE"):
137	            self.take()
138	            b = self.expr()
139	            if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
140	                if a is None or b is None:
141	                    r = (a is None and b is None)
142	                else:
143	                    r = abs(a - b) < 1e-9
144	                return r if op == "EQ" else not r
145	            a = 0.0 if a is None else a
146	            b = 0.0 if b is None else b
147	            return {"GT": a > b, "GE": a >= b, "LT": a < b, "LE": a <= b}[op]
148	        return a
149	
150	    def expr(self):
151	        v = self.term()
152	        while self.peek() in ("+", "-", "OR", "XOR"):
153	            op = self.take()
154	            w = self.term()
155	            v, w = (v or 0.0), (w or 0.0)
156	            v = v + w if op == "+" else v - w if op == "-" else float(int(v) | int(w)) if op == "OR" \
157	                else float(int(v) ^ int(w))
158	        return v
159	
160	    def term(self):
161	        v = self.factor()
162	        while self.peek() in ("*", "/", "AND", "MOD"):
163	            op = self.take()
164	            w = self.factor()
165	            v, w = (v or 0.0), (w or 0.0)
166	            if op == "*":
167	                v = v * w
168	            elif op == "/":
169	                v = v / w
170	            elif op == "AND":
171	                v = float(int(v) & int(w))
172	            else:
173	                v = math.fmod(v, w)
174	        return v
175	
176	    def factor(self):
177	        tok = self.peek()
178	        if tok == "-":
179	            self.take()
180	            v = self.factor()
181	            return None if v is None else -v
182	        if tok == "+":
183	            self.take()
184	            return self.factor()
185	        if tok == "[":
186	            self.take()
187	            v = self.expr()
188	            self.take("]")
189	            return v
190	        if tok == "#":
191	            self.take()
192	            n = self.factor()
193	            return self.I.getvar(int(round(n)))
194	        if tok in ("SIN", "COS", "TAN", "SQRT", "ABS", "ROUND", "FIX", "FUP", "ATAN"):
195	            self.take()
196	            self.take("[")
197	            v = self.expr() or 0.0
198	            self.take("]")
199	            if tok == "SIN":
200	                return math.sin(math.radians(v))
201	            if tok == "COS":
202	                return math.cos(math.radians(v))
203	            if tok == "TAN":
204	                return math.tan(math.radians(v))
205	            if tok == "SQRT":
206	                return math.sqrt(v)
207	            if tok == "ABS":
208	                return abs(v)
209	            if tok == "ROUND":
210	                return math.floor(abs(v) + 0.5) * (1 if v >= 0 else -1)
211	            if tok == "FIX":
212	                return float(math.trunc(v))
213	            if tok == "FUP":
214	                return float(math.trunc(v) + (0 if v == math.trunc(v) else (1 if v > 0 else -1)))
215	            raise NCError("ATAN not supported")
216	        if tok is None:
217	            raise NCError("unexpected end of expression")
218	        self.take()
219	        return float(tok)

223	def rot(v, deg):
224	    a = math.radians(deg)
225	    return (v[0] * math.cos(a) - v[1] * math.sin(a), v[0] * math.sin(a) + v[1] * math.cos(a))

228	def arc_center(p0, p1, r, ccw):
229	    """centre of the arc p0->p1 with radius R (negative: more than 180 deg)"""
230	    dx, dy = p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1]
231	    d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
232	    rr = abs(r)
233	    if d > 2 * rr + 1e-6:
234	        raise NCError("arc radius too small")
235	    h = math.sqrt(max(rr * rr - d * d / 4, 0.0))
236	    mx, my = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2
237	    nx, ny = -dy / d, dx / d          # left normal of chord
238	    # minor arc ccw -> centre on the left of the chord
239	    side = 1 if ccw else -1
240	    if r < 0:
241	        side = -side
242	    return (mx + side * h * nx, my + side * h * ny)

245	class Seg:
246	    """planar XY path element in program coordinates at height z"""
247	
248	    def __init__(self, kind, p0, p1, z, center=None, ccw=None):
249	        self.kind, self.p0, self.p1, self.z, self.c, self.ccw = kind, p0, p1, z, center, ccw
250	
251	    def radius(self):
252	        return math.hypot(self.p0[0] - self.c[0], self.p0[1] - self.c[1])
253	
254	    def tangent(self, at_end):
255	        if self.kind == "L":
256	            dx, dy = self.p1[0] - self.p0[0], self.p1[1] - self.p0[1]
257	            n = math.hypot(dx, dy)
258	            return (dx / n, dy / n)
259	        p = self.p1 if at_end else self.p0
260	        rx, ry = p[0] - self.c[0], p[1] - self.c[1]
261	        n = math.hypot(rx, ry)
262	        return (-ry / n, rx / n) if self.ccw else (ry / n, -rx / n)

265	def left(t):
266	    return (-t[1], t[0])

269	def offset_seg(s, d, side):
270	    """offset a segment by d to the left (side=+1) or right (side=-1)"""
271	    if s.kind == "L":
272	        n = left(s.tangent(False))
273	        o = (n[0] * d * side, n[1] * d * side)
274	        return Seg("L", (s.p0[0] + o[0], s.p0[1] + o[1]), (s.p1[0] + o[0], s.p1[1] + o[1]), s.z)
275	    r = s.radius()
276	    # left of a ccw arc is the inside
277	    inward = (1 if s.ccw else -1) * side
278	    nr = r - inward * d
279	    if nr <= 1e-9:
280	        raise NCError("offset arc radius not positive (interference)")
281	    def mv(p):
282	        rx, ry = p[0] - s.c[0], p[1] - s.c[1]
283	        k = nr / math.hypot(rx, ry)
284	        return (s.c[0] + rx * k, s.c[1] + ry * k)
285	    return Seg("A", mv(s.p0), mv(s.p1), s.z, s.c, s.ccw)

288	def intersect(a, b, near):
289	    """intersection of offset elements a and b (as infinite line / full circle) nearest to `near`"""
290	    pts = []
291	    if a.kind == "L" and b.kind == "L":
292	        d1 = (a.p1[0] - a.p0[0], a.p1[1] - a.p0[1])
293	        d2 = (b.p1[0] - b.p0[0], b.p1[1] - b.p0[1])
294	        den = d1[0] * d2[1] - d1[1] * d2[0]
295	        if abs(den) < 1e-12:
296	            return None
297	        t = ((b.p0[0] - a.p0[0]) * d2[1] - (b.p0[1] - a.p0[1]) * d2[0]) / den
298	        return (a.p0[0] + t * d1[0], a.p0[1] + t * d1[1])
299	    if a.kind == "A" and b.kind == "A":
300	        c1, r1, c2, r2 = a.c, a.radius(), b.c, b.radius()
301	        dx, dy = c2[0] - c1[0], c2[1] - c1[1]
302	        d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
303	        if d < 1e-12:
304	            return None
305	        x = (d * d + r1 * r1 - r2 * r2) / (2 * d)
306	        h2 = r1 * r1 - x * x
307	        if h2 < -1e-9:
308	            return None
309	        h = math.sqrt(max(h2, 0))
310	        bx, by = c1[0] + x * dx / d, c1[1] + x * dy / d
311	        pts = [(bx - h * dy / d, by + h * dx / d), (bx + h * dy / d, by - h * dx / d)]
312	    else:
313	        ln, ar = (a, b) if a.kind == "L" else (b, a)
314	        d = (ln.p1[0] - ln.p0[0], ln.p1[1] - ln.p0[1])
315	        n = math.hypot(*d)
316	        d = (d[0] / n, d[1] / n)
317	        f = (ln.p0[0] - ar.c[0], ln.p0[1] - ar.c[1])
318	        bq = f[0] * d[0] + f[1] * d[1]
319	        cq = f[0] ** 2 + f[1] ** 2 - ar.radius() ** 2
320	        disc = bq * bq - cq
321	        if disc < -1e-9:
322	            return None
323	        sq = math.sqrt(max(disc, 0))
324	        pts = [(ln.p0[0] + (-bq + s) * d[0], ln.p0[1] + (-bq + s) * d[1]) for s in (sq, -sq)]
325	    return min(pts, key=lambda p: math.hypot(p[0] - near[0], p[1] - near[1]))
326
